I visited the surgery in 2024 due to feeling awful, worse than when I had Covid. I had waited days before ringing, hoping whatever it was that I had would pass and could be treated at home. I saw Dr Khan, who was extremely dismissive, told me I had a viral infection and that I needed to be patient. No other advice was offered. She was very cold and made me feel like I was wasting her time.
